meta.title: Berry Avenue RP jobs data

sources.label: BioBlox - Berry Avenue RP Guide: Jobs, Best Roles & How to Roleplay

meta.notes: Roleplay roles selected from the in-game phone Jobs menu. Berry Avenue has no in-game currency, so these roles do not pay money or wages. Roster limited to roles sources confirm as Jobs-menu entries. Per-role icons are not reliably available, so the catalog launches image-light.

items.name: Doctor / Nurse
items.cardSummary: Work out of the hospital, treat injured players, and run medical roleplay scenarios with patients and other staff.

items.name: Firefighter
items.cardSummary: Respond to emergencies and fire callouts around town, working as part of the emergency response side of roleplay.

items.name: Lifeguard
items.cardSummary: Watch over the pool or beach area and keep swimmers safe, a relaxed role with plenty of social roleplay.

items.name: Police Officer
items.cardSummary: Patrol the streets, respond to incidents, and arrest rule-breakers as part of law-enforcement roleplay.

items.name: Barista
items.cardSummary: Serve drinks at the Coffee House, the main social hub, and chat with the players who gather there.

items.name: Chef
items.cardSummary: Cook and prepare food at a restaurant or in your own home for family and customer roleplay.

items.name: Grocery Store Worker
items.cardSummary: Stock shelves and help customers at the grocery store for everyday shopping roleplay.

items.name: Hairdresser / Beauty Tech
items.cardSummary: Style players at the salon and run makeover and beauty roleplay for customers.

items.name: Bus Driver
items.cardSummary: Run routes around town and pick up students and commuters for travel roleplay.

items.name: Pilot / Flight Attendant
items.cardSummary: Take on airport roleplay with travel storylines, flying passengers or looking after them in the cabin.

items.name: Taxi Driver
items.cardSummary: Drive people around town and build short pickup-and-dropoff roleplay scenes with passengers.
